after.title_zh: 形成能力、实际运用与接续
after.title_en: Formed capacity, actual exercise and continuation
after.claim_zh: 能力已形成、能力实际被运用、下轮条件得到再形成是不同关系；任意高的有限完成可能，不能仅凭这些替代可能性推出一条实际持续形成的历史。 固定规律下的旧可达性区分现细化为共同实现的准备步骤界：实际准备可改变当前一步能力，解除共同条件可失去最终共同实现，已有能力也可能未被使用。
after.claim_en: Formed capacity, its actual exercise and renewed next-stage conditions are distinct; arbitrarily high finite completion possibilities do not by themselves establish one history of ongoing actual formation. The existing fixed-law reachability distinction now has an explicit preparation bound for joint realization: actual preparation can change current one-step capacity, release can remove eventual joint realization, and available capacity can remain unused.

after.scope_en: Local Lean and independent reconstruction checked; ethical identity open; bounded-refinement module checks 12 theorem declarations/18 audits, including restated prior inferences rather than 12 independent results; origin and full target remain open
